plain.li: [call:hail,w:spacer] Opening a channel to {TOWN}. This is {TO} of {COLONY}.
[call:hail,war] {TOWN}, this is {COLONY}, under a white flag. Will you talk?
[call:pickup,warm|cordial] {COLONY}, I hear you, and it's good to. Go ahead.
[call:pickup,warm] {TO}, is that you? Good to hear your voice.
[call:pickup,refusal] We know who you are. Say what you have to say.
[call:pickup,w:medieval] Is this the device? Is it working? Ah. This is {FROM}. Speak.
[call:pickup,war] We hear you, {COLONY}. Speak under your white flag.
[call:reply,warm] That's good to hear. Thank you, truly.
[call:reply,warm] I'll tell everyone here. They'll be glad.
[call:reply,cordial] Understood. Thank you for your time.
[call:reply,cool] I see. Thank you all the same.
[call:reply,war] Then we'll keep listening, in case you change your mind.
[call:bye,warm] Good talking to you. Look after yourselves. {TOWN} out.
[call:bye,w:medieval] Now how does one make it stop? Ah. Farewell.
[call:back,warm] {COLONY}, {FROM} here. Sorry I missed you earlier.
[call:back,war] {COLONY}. {TOWN} returning your call, under your white flag.
[call:answer] Thanks for calling back. Go ahead.
[call:word] This is {FROM} at {TOWN}, for {COLONY}. Nobody answered, so I'll leave this.
[call:word] {COLONY}, {TOWN} here, returning your call. I'll leave word.
[call:word,warm|cordial] {FROM} for {COLONY}. Sorry to miss you. Here's my answer.
[call:word,cool|curt|refusal] {TOWN} for {COLONY}. You called. Here is our answer.
[call:word,w:medieval] Speak to the box, they say. Very well. This is {FROM} of {TOWN}.
[call:wordbye,warm] Call me when you can. {TOWN} out.
[call:wordbye,w:medieval] Is it done? I think it is done.
